out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Required & Posted
violations.observation: The food establishment's Permit to Operate is no longer valid due to expiration of the permit. No person shall operate a food establishment unless that person possesses a valid permit issued by the Health Department.
violations.corrective_action: To obtain a current Permit to Operate, contact the Health Department at (703) 246-2201 within 48 hours to make payment of the permit renewal fee. You may provide payment by cash, check, or credit card. Failure to pay the permit renewal fee and obtain a current Permit to Operate within 48 hours may lead to further enforcement actions by the Health Department including immediate closure. Paid during inspection visit.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at kitchen 88F and guest restroom 91F is not reaching at least 100F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed chicken tamales in steam wells at 125F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19.CFM reheated chicken tamales to 165F or above
